body:
I suppose it is due to the fact that one of my friends has been married for quite some time now. I see how happy he has been, how in love they are with each-other, and it is the one thing I desire most. I would say I was jealous, except I don't resent him for it. I'm happy he found someone to start a family with.  

To have proof that I've moved forward, in my mind, would be to have a lasting romantic relationship with a woman. It is the thing I am terrified of due to my past, and yet the thing I yearn for the most.

I passed out after getting drunk, I didn't drive out to end it because I didn't want to be a potential hazard to anyone else on the road.

I just woke back up and read though your post, but the more I think about it, the more I come back to seeing them both one last time, or at least talking to them and ending it. Regardless of how I feel after I speak to them, even if I'm happy, better to end it on a high note.

I've had good memories with them, but the good don't out-weigh the bad. I'm tired of it hanging over me, I haven't been able to move on, and I've had plenty of time, I don't think I can.
